Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.

criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of catastrophic forgetting.
Practice: the definitions separate valid from invalid cases.
Measurement: report old-task loss after each new task against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reporting only final-task accuracy; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
